address: 10 rue de la Gare, Ellange, 5690, Luxembourg
bio: Daniel Rameau is a connoisseur of luxury produce, among which foie gras, lobster and pigeon, which he prepares refreshingly simply in dishes that blend generosity and tradition. The equally enticing wine list features a savvy selection of Luxemburg vintages. This former village train station and its flower-decked terrace are steeped in vintage charm....
